intro: The Marshall Islands has about 40,000 people, and many have moved to the US.

chapters.title: People
text: Most people are Marshallese. Marshallese and English are official. Most people are Christian. Large communities live in Arkansas and Hawaii.

chapters.title: Majuro
text: Majuro atoll holds the capital and about half the people.

keyTerms.meaning: A high chief in the Marshall Islands.
